decisions.reason: F4 falsely covered every projective-space product: CP^1 x CP^1 has hyperbolic middle form and signature zero. The proof uses only the basis products CP^{2k_i} with k_i>=1, exactly licensed by the product lemma, and handles the positive point separately. Restricting F4 repairs this nonfatal overstatement; Q-linear equality on the basis, zero extension and equality with the unital L-genus homomorphism establish the unchanged theorem.

The remark wrongly excluded zero extension from the signature theorem and said both interfaces were limited to dimensions 4k, although the theorem explicitly asserts equality of the zero-extended signature and L-genus on all rational oriented bordism degrees. This contradicts the main scope explanation. Repaired prose distinguishes the geometric middle-form definition in dimensions 4k from the all-degree algebraic formulation, preserving multiplicativity of the zero extension and the caveat that the 4k+2 middle pairing is alternating, not an inertia form.

F7 omitted the smoothness hypothesis of cor-four-dimensional-signature-formula; the supplied Pontryagin number uses the smooth tangent bundle and no topological extension is licensed here. This is nonfatal for the example because F4 establishes that S^2 x S^2 has the product smooth structure. Added smooth to F7 and restored F1/F3 tags at step 4.1. Integral and real Kunneth bases, normalized product evaluation and the orthogonal basis a+b,a-b give diag(2,-2), so signature zero and p1=3 sigma=0 remain established.
